questions.question: During phase change, average kinetic energy of the molecules of the substance
In the part of the transition curve where the temperature decreases,

answers.a: the kinetic energy decreases while the potential energy stays the same
answers.b: the potential energy decreases while the kinetic energy stays the same
answers.c: kinetic energy as well as potential energy changes

questions.question: The amount of energy needed to melt 'm' gram of a solid substance to its liquid form is

answers.a: $Q= mCdT$, where C is the Specific heat capacity of the substance
answers.b: $Q=mLf$ ,where Lf is the Latent heat of fusion of the substance
answers.c: $Q=(T_{2}^{4}-T_{1}^{4})$, where T1 and T2 are the temperatures of the body and the surroundings
